The center of attention. Flirtatious, luxurious, and gorgeous. Hard to pin down, but the master of the grand entrance.

Name

Choose a name from one of these lists, or make up your own:

  • Constanza, Marcela, Soraya, Regina, Verónica.

  • Armando, Guillermo, Rafael, Rolando, Vicente

Look

Choose at least one option from each list:

  • Luxurious hair, silky hair, voluminous hairstyle, messy hair.

  • Sly eyes, flirtatious eyes, doe eyes, fiery eyes.

  • Designer clothes, provocative outfit, haute couture clothes, city clothes.

Your Question

  • Are you the center of attention?

Relationships

  • You flirt with __________, a good source of entertainment you like to keep on hand.

  • When you really need to let loose, you go find __________.

Conditions

  • Zealous: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.TcWPAx8tGRie1Sb6]{demand what you deserve}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act with desperation}.

  • Raging: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{spot something out of place}.

  • Lustful: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.wQO9aJp5sChjcoUG]{process your feelings}.

  • Underhanded: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.3EdfFL5zzGRV5Oxt]{manipulate a superior}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse someone of lying}.

Meltdown

They think they can spurn you, treat you like trash? Not anymore. You throw yourself at the object of your greatest affection. You confess how long you've needed them and how desperately. Maybe you show them how good they could have it. Maybe you destroy something beautiful so they can only see you. Tomorrow they'll see you through eyes that know your fragility...but tonight you'll be without walls.

Last Time On

At the beginning of each episode, choose one from the list below and cross it off. Once all are gone, it's time for the series finale.

  • In the arms of another character, you spotted something you want to seize.

  • You signed a contract with a flourish-filled signature.

  • You crashed into something with your gorgeous, gleaming car.

  • You befriended someone dangerous and passionate.

  • In a fit of rage, you threw your glass of wine in a character's face.

  • You fell into the arms of a lover of lower standing.

  • You slipped something into somebody's possession without them knowing

Moves

CHOOSE TWO.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.QwJEGX9960x06W4B]{Hard to Pin Down}

When someone tries to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express their love passionately} to you, @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuses you of lying}, or tries to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{spot something out of place} about you, you can interfere by remaining aloof or coy. Roll with the questions:

  • Are they being cruel?

  • Are you in public?

On a hit (7+), they take -2 on their roll. On a 10+, they also reveal their true feelings to you. On a miss (6-), they can improve their roll to a 10+ or make you mark a condition, their choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.NCQ5VhpcPRkHrZm7]{Big Entrance}

When you enter a room ready to make a scene, roll +1 for each person in the room with whom you've been intimate (max +4).

On a hit (7+), anyone you've been intimate with is surprised, frightened, or confused.

On a 10+, you've seized control of the room; take +1 ongoing as long as you keep attention on yourself and don't let anyone stand in your way.

On a miss (6-), they don't give you the reaction you wanted; mark a condition and blurt out a secret or pour out your emotions for all to see, your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.wW7XXQDL4KnTFs2x]{Up, Boy}

When you @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love passionately} or @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.TcWPAx8tGRie1Sb6]{demand what you deserve} by riling someone up while remaining aloof, add the question "Are you physically touching them?" to the list of questions for the move.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.12QYcohvLsJviIyH]{Ice Queen}

When you reject someone immediately after @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{expressing your love passionately}, clear a condition or inflict a condition on them.

Excessive, protective, and direct, El Caballero tackles things head-on. He is prone to grand gestures and taking a stand.

Name

Choose a name from one of these lists, or make up your own:

  • Dolores, Guadalupe, Lourdes, Malena, Raquel.

  • Álvaro, Domingo, José, Lorenzo, Mariano

Look

Choose at least one option from each list:

  • Smoothed hair, ragged hair, shaved hair, cascading hair .

  • Sharp eyes, angry eyes, tired eyes, searching eyes.

  • Casual clothes, professional clothes, uniform clothes, protective clothes

Your Question

  • Are you handling things straightforwardly and without guile?

Relationships

  • ______ is the person you go to when you're stuck. They have seen your softer side.

  • ______ knew you when you used to get in trouble. They have seen your harder side.

Conditions

  • Engrossed: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{spot something out of place}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love}.

  • Cornered: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act desperately}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.TcWPAx8tGRie1Sb6]{demand what you deserve}.

  • Vicious: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.wQO9aJp5sChjcoUG]{process your feelings}.

  • Condemning: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse someone of lying to}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.3EdfFL5zzGRV5Oxt]{manipulate a superior}.

Meltdown

There's a line between justice and vengeance. Sometimes. That's done now. You go directly to the object of your enmity and bring them that justice. You throw their sins in their face and mete out punishment. Maybe you lock them up in a jail or a cellar. Maybe you finish things once
and for all. Tomorrow they'll know you've always been a brute...but tonight they'll face you and know truth.

Last Time On

At the beginning of each episode, choose one from the list below and cross it off. Once all are gone, it's time for the series finale.

  • You got into a scrap that you barely got out of alive.

  • You uncovered a letter that ties you deeply to someone.

  • You bare-handedly touched a weapon that has since gone missing.

  • You agreed to work with the authorities to trick someone.

  • You spilled a piece of your sordid past, tears in your eyes

  • You spotted two people embracing through a window.

  • You put in some hard work to get something fixed.

Moves

CHOOSE TWO.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.6ppaFljuWNHLcskx]{Grand Gesture}

When you @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love passionately}, add the question "Are you making this absurdly elaborate and excessive?" to the list of questions. If your target gives themselves to you or tells you they love you, clear a condition.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.y7fZ5irSzR0l2IrX]{Size Up}

When you try to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{spot something out of place}, ask one of these questions, even on a miss (6-):

  • Where is the nearest weapon?
  • What are they trying to hide?
  • What's their way out?

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.BG4qMIrOHxACbRK4]{For Your Protection}

When you offer your protection to someone and they accept, hold 1. You may spend that hold to appear in a scene with them at any time or move to exactly where you need to be to protect them before anyone can interfere.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.yU2ogGDUKNuJnelc]{Take a Stand}

When you step in to defend someone, roll with the questions:

  • Are you trying to impress them?

  • Is the law being broken?

On a 7-9, hold 1. On a 10+, hold 3. While you stand in their defense, you may spend hold one-for-one to:

  • Protect them from an attack; take the hit instead of them.

  • Keep someone from leaving a room unless they go through you.

  • Take +1 on @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{striking out with violence} against someone who threatens harm.

On a miss (6-), you show your hand too soon; you're at their mercy, and the aggressor can inflict a condition on you or the target.

Manipulative, vengeful, and powerful, La Doña weaves her web behind the scenes. Scheming, but perhaps with fond memories of what they once were.

Name

Choose a name from one of these lists, or make up your own:

  • Altagracia, Angélica, Camila, Carmina, Graciela

  • Bernardo, Isidro, Octavio, Santiago, Valencio.

Look

Choose at least one option from each list:

  • Controlled hair, dyed hair, silvering hair, luxurious hair

  • Measuring eyes, skeptical eyes, thoughtful eyes, welcoming eyes

  • Formal clothes, professional clothes, tailored clothes, youthful clothes.

Your Question

  • Are you keeping your hands clean?

Relationships

  • __________ is someone you've sparred with for a very long time.

  • __________ is like a broken little bird you take care of.

Conditions

  • Chiding: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse someone of lying}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out}.

  • Righteous: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.TcWPAx8tGRie1Sb6]{demand what you deserve}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.3EdfFL5zzGRV5Oxt]{manipulate a superior}.

  • Ruminative: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.wQO9aJp5sChjcoUG]{process your feelings}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love}.

  • Cautious: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{spot something out of place}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act with desperation}.

Meltdown

The ungrateful whelps take and take. It's time to cut off the worms leeching off of you. You put them in line and show them how grateful they should be. Maybe you throw them out onto the
street and let them work for a change. Maybe you make public changes to your estate and show where your favor lies. Tomorrow you'll find yourself alone...but tonight you'll show them what it is to live without your protection and generosity.

Last Time On

At the beginning of each episode, choose one from the list below and cross it off. Once all are gone, it's time for the series finale.

  • You manipulated your name onto a lease, contract, or deed.

  • You comforted someone in their time of need and meant it

  • You handed someone a weapon with whispers of encouragement.

  • You shouted someone down and left them distraught.

  • You used your resources to buy someone out of a bad spot.

  • You called in a favor but nobody came to your aid.

  • You showed your deep, hidden feelings to someone you shouldn't have

Your Network

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.CuWS2El45EDr569i]{Your Network}

Choose two Schemes on which your network has been working. Tell everyone the Schemes you've chosen. You may not have more than two Schemes at a time, but you may halt one and begin a new one at the beginning of any session.

  • Seize Property. Choose a known property or valuable object. You have someone keeping an eye on it full time. When it changes hands, you know.
  • Opportunity. Choose someone who has, in your opinion, wronged you. Your network will let you know immediately when they are alone.
  • Protection. Choose a character or thing your network protects. They keep them safe from death and serious harm as long as they are under your protection.
  • Bring Them Together. Choose two characters. You convinced society that they belong and are together. When they are intimate with others, you learn of it.
  • Keep Them Apart. Choose two characters. Through your machinations, you are keeping them apart. When they make plans to meet, you learn of them.

Moves

CHOOSE TWO.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.T0VZ8PAz1POrA1Ch]{Into the Lion's Den}

When you arrive at someone's doorstep to meet with them in good faith, tell them you are here to deal under the rules of decency—while you are in their abode, neither of you can attack, steal from, record, or otherwise physically act against the other. If they admit you, they clear a condition. After they admit you, if they are an NPC, they must follow the rules. If a PC (either La Doña or the other party) breaks these rules, then they can no longer take +1 for the questions on any moves until they are forgiven or the session ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.3kjWPv0fayWjwKZm]{You Did What?}

Add the question "Are you taking advantage of someone's shame?" as a playbook question. You may choose which playbook question to use each time you roll.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.FOfaENDyASNUGlzJ]{Tell Me Everything}

When you offer to take the burden of someone's guilt, ask them if they accept or reject your advice. If they accept your advice and follow it, they clear a condition. If they reject your advice or fail to follow it, they mark a condition.

The naive hard-working innocent. Heartfelt, downtrodden, and loving. Searching for a better life in all things, love especially.

Name

Choose a name from one of these lists, or make up your own:

  • Aurora, Beatriz, Juana, María, Reina

  • Gabriel, Juan, Luis, Rubin, Sergio

Look

Choose at least one option from each list:

  • Messy hair, pulled back hair, unassuming hair, braided hair

  • Beautiful eyes, demure eyes, intelligent eyes, wide eyes.

  • Casual clothes, concealing clothes, professional clothes, work clothes.

Your Question

  • Are you in over your head?

Relationships

  • __________ looms large in your life as your employer.

  • __________ was the first person who was nice to you despite your humble beginnings.

Conditions

  • Hopeless: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{spot something out of place}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse someone of lying}.

  • Lovelorn: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act with desperation}.

  • Cagey: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.3EdfFL5zzGRV5Oxt]{manipulate a superior}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.TcWPAx8tGRie1Sb6]{demand what you deserve}.

  • Introspective: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.wQO9aJp5sChjcoUG]{process your feelings out loud}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out}.

Meltdown

All of this deception and plotting is simply too much for your pure heart. You seek solace in the arms of the closest sympathetic person. You spill your guts to them about all your feelings. Maybe you fall into the arms of an old
love. Maybe you go back to someone who's burned you before. Tomorrow you'll have to face the consequences...but tonight you'll take comfort where you can find it.

Last Time On

At the beginning of each episode, choose one from the list below and cross it off. Once all are gone, it's time for the series finale.

  • You came so very, very close to kissing someone you shouldn't.

  • You acquired the most beautiful, elegant outfit you've ever seen.

  • You pushed someone in a fit of anger and hurt them more than you wanted.

  • You intercepted a letter meant for someone else.

  • You witnessed something horrible but don't know who did it.

  • You hid something where it will hopefully be safe.

  • You told a dear friend a secret that should have stayed undisclosed.

Your Suitors

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.Gx47kmT6VpZkoCMg]{Your Suitors}

Choose two people (ideally player characters) to be your Suitors; they are actively courting you, even if you're already in a relationship. At the beginning of play, choose one to be your Love. ________________________________ ________________________________

Take +1 ongoing with your Love when you act to strengthen the relationship.

When you share intimacy or feelings with a Suitor who is not currently your Love, make them your new Love. If you initiated the intimacy, clear a condition. If they initiated the intimacy, they clear a condition.

At any time that you insult, break up with, or are disappointed by a Suitor, you can break the ties with them and choose someone else to take their place.

Moves

CHOOSE ONE.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.Bj5Eg5IZe9cOsHHx]{Confesión}

When you tell someone of your wrongdoings, roll with the questions:

  • Do you view the other as pure of heart?

  • Do you invoke religion or family?

On a hit (7+), you feel your soul lightened and clear a condition.

On a 7-9, you give them enough detail that they can later prove your wrongdoings or they can immediately clear a condition themselves, their choice.

On a miss (6-), the worst person possible overhears you.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.8piIhXIicJklnUnC]{You Brute!}

When you @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out with voice or violence} or @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse someone of lying} while you have four conditions marked, ignore all penalties from conditions for those moves.

When you @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out} at your Love or @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse your Love of lying}, you may immediately swap your Love to the other Suitor to take a 10+ on the move.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.weIWut2EUA9r0gfd]{Keys to the Castle}

When you reveal that you've been secretly listening to a whole conversation, roll with the questions:

  • Do you work here?

  • Are you dressed to blend in?

On a 7-9, you get away, but someone saw you—you pick who it was.

On a 10+, you got away without being spotted or you ask the conspirators a follow-up question, your choice.

On a miss (6-), you stumble, knock something over, or otherwise reveal yourself. You're in the thick of it.

The dastardly twin. Jealous, destructive, and misunderstood. Almost the same as their twin, but a spinner of lies and half-truths.


Before you start, ask the other players if they are willing to be your twin. Choose from among those who agree, or work with the MC to pick an important NPC!

Name

Choose a name like your
twin's:
________________________________

Look

Choose at least one option from each list:

  • Bouncier hair, darker hair, longer hair, slicker hair.

  • Angrier eyes, colder eyes, darker eyes, sexier eyes.

  • Expensive clothes, risqué clothes, fashionable clothes, dark clothes.

Your Question

  • Are you taking advantage of your twin's reputation?

Relationships

  • __________ is your twin and has something you want more than anything else in the world.

  • __________ met you before they met your twin. They can usually tell it's you.

Conditions

  • Cornered: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act with desperation}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.TcWPAx8tGRie1Sb6]{demand what you deserve}.

  • Guarded: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.3EdfFL5zzGRV5Oxt]{manipulate a superior}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out}.

  • Driven: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse someone of lying}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love}.

  • Brooding: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.wQO9aJp5sChjcoUG]{process your feelings out loud}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{spot something out of place}.

Meltdown

For too long you've measured success by your twin. No more. You claim the thing that they most treasure. Maybe you enjoy the riches, power, or delights you stole. Maybe you light it up and watch it burn. Tomorrow you'll surely have to face your twin...but tonight you'll show them you can take their life if you truly want it.

Last Time On

At the beginning of each episode, choose one from the list below and cross it off. Once all are gone, it's time for the series finale.

  • You got into your twin's home and left something behind.

  • You fought with your twin and one of you nearly died.

  • You received a large sum of money from a mysterious benefactor.

  • You acquired proof of your parentage.

  • You were approached by someone who threatened to spill your secret.

  • You watched your twin, unaware someone was watching you.

  • You showed up at an event with your twin.

Moves

CHOOSE ONE.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.JdSEoJwvtpUwwhn8]{That Wasn't Me}

When someone sets a scene with you or your twin, mark a condition to switch which one of you is really there.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.Uw7HZwTQH6CoSLoI]{Almost the Same}

When you @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love passionately} to someone that your twin loves, treat a miss (6-) as a 7-9, and a 7-9 as a 10+.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.9WDsgt2w3PEgDf6C]{Story Spinner}

When you coyly attempt to learn about someone while you are pretending to be your twin, roll with the questions:

  • Do they love your twin?

  • Is there an ample distraction?

On a 7-9, hold 1. On a 10+, hold 3. Spend hold one-for-one to ask any of these questions:

  • What moment of intimacy have you and my twin shared?

  • How do you feel about my twin?

  • What do you owe my twin?

  • How could I make you angry at my twin?

On a miss (6-), you show your hand; they realize you aren't who you claim to be.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.pFEQz9XJ5ve7tJOo]{Twin Tied}

When pretending to be your twin, you may mark a condition to use one of their moves as if it was yours.

Authoritarian, hot-tempered, and menacing, El Jefe commands his henchmen to seize control of the situation.

Name

Choose a name from one of these lists, or make up your own:

  • Catalina, Dulcina, Evangelina, Marcia, Soraya.

  • Eladio, Ernesto, Federico, Octavio, Roberto.

Look

Choose at least one option from each list:

  • Business-like hair, gelled hair, jet hair, styled hair.

  • Angry eyes, paranoid eyes, searching eyes, sultry eyes.

  • Formal clothes, uniform clothes, expensive clothes, understated clothes.

Your Question

  • Are you taking control of this situation?

Relationships

  • __________ has been a thorn in your side and a constant irritation.

  • __________ is an object of beauty you have sworn to possess.

Conditions

Meltdown

They think they can manipulate you, displace you. They don't understand—you own them!
You directly confront the worst offender and hurt them. You show them that you don't need money or backup. Maybe you destroy things they love. Maybe you cut some throats. Tomorrow you'll have to wash your hands and play nice...but tonight the blood on your knuckles will match the rage in your heart.

Last Time On

At the beginning of each episode, choose one from the list below and cross it off. Once all are gone, it's time for the series finale.

  • You showed someone a moment of tender weakness.

  • You swore to take revenge against someone important.

  • You took over a business or political seat as an interim leader.

  • You revealed that you know a secret truth hidden from someone.

  • You lost something truly valuable that you must recover.

  • You lost your temper and hurt one of your associates.

  • You tightened your grip on something until it snapped.

Thugs

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.wWx0NWU8412n505s]{Thugs}

You have a small crew ready to enforce your plans, about 4–6 people. Give them names. When you send them to rough up a target, answer the following questions, and roll the dice:

  • Is it an easy assignment?

  • Is the crew well rested and in good health?

On a hit (7+), they show up to rough up your target. On a 7-9, your target chooses one. On a 10+, your target chooses two:

  • The crew makes a clear demand; your target gives your crew what you're looking for.

  • The crew beats up your target; your target marks a condition.

  • The crew intimidates your target; your target gives up something else of value to appease them.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{Accuse Someone of Lying}

When you accuse someone of lying to their face, roll with the questions:

  • Do you have an audience?

  • Do you have evidence?

On a 7-9, choose one. On a 10+, choose two:

  • You are right despite what the audience has already seen.

  • They must admit their falsehood or mark a condition.

  • They're surprised, scared, or flustered; they must @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act with desperation} before they can act against you.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{Act With Desperation}

When you act with desperation, tell the MC what situation you want to avoid, and roll with the questions:

  • Are you doing this for love?

  • Are you doing this for vengeance?

On a hit, you avoid the situation you wanted to avoid. On a 10+, you also manage to hold everything together and avoid further complication. On a 7-9, mark a condition or the MC will give you an unforeseen consequence or added complication.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{Express Your Love Passionately}

When you express your love passionately, roll with the questions:

  • Are you dressed to impress?

  • Do they believe that you are single?

On a hit, your target gives themself to you or reveals a secret they probably shouldn't. On a 10+, they also tell you whether they love you or not, and who else they love.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.TcWPAx8tGRie1Sb6]{Demand What You Deserve}

When you demand what you deserve, roll with the questions:

  • Are you offering something of value in return?

  • Do they love you in this moment?

On a hit, the target of your demand chooses one. On a 10+, remove one of their options and they choose one from the remaining:

  • They concede to you; they can clear a condition.

  • They refuse and escalate; they mark a condition.

  • They run away; you take something from them.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.wQO9aJp5sChjcoUG]{Process Your Feelings Out Loud}

When you process your feelings out loud, ask each member of the audience if they are rooting for you, each one giving you a +1 or +0 (max +3), and roll.

On a hit, choose one:

  • The audience reveals a crucial event going on outside of view.

  • The audience tells you how you might find love with a partner of their choosing.

  • The audience tells you how to get ______ to _______.

Take +1 ongoing while following up on this information. On a 10+, set the scene where you follow that information immediately.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.3EdfFL5zzGRV5Oxt]{Manipulate a Superior}

When you manipulate a social superior, tell them what you want them to do and roll with the questions:

  • Have you caught them in a good mood?

  • Does your well-being directly affect theirs?

On a hit, they give into your wiles and agree to do it. On a 7-9, they need a bit more convincing. You choose:

  • Humble or abase yourself; mark a condition.

  • Give them something they want first.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{Spot Something Out of Place}

When you try to spot something out of place in a social interaction or someone's personal space, roll with the questions:

  • Have you been intimate with them recently?

  • Are you free of other distractions?

On a hit, ask two questions. On a 7-9, they ask you one question, too.

  • How does your character feel about ______?

  • What are you planning?

  • How could I get your character to ______?

  • What do you have of value or use?

  • What do you hope to get from ______?

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{Strike Out With Voice or Violence}

When you strike out at someone with voice or violence, roll with the questions:

  • Have you caught them off guard?

  • Have they just wronged you?

On a hit, your strike lands and you each mark a condition. On a 10+, you also take something from them or avoid marking a condition.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.H1y45QiS6PYPAUL7]{Face Certain Death}

When you face certain death, roll the dice with your conditions marked.

On a miss (6-), your death was less certain than we thought; tell us about your daring escape. On a 7-9, you choose one from the list. On a 10+, the audience chooses one from the list. When an option is chosen, it is crossed off; nobody may choose it again.

  • Someone (you choose) saves you just in time.

  • Take a distinctive, but sexy, scar.

  • Gain a permanent debility (a limp, an eyepatch, etc.).

  • Become a twisted, evil version of yourself.

  • Suffer amnesia.

Flashback Moves

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.pL8aMNqpQhUZxBpo]{Reveal a Shocking Truth}

When you flash back to reveal a shocking truth about a PC in front of you, roll the dice with your conditions marked, then mark a condition.

On a hit (7+), the news is staggering; the person you're speaking to must @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act with desperation} before they can act against you. On a 7-9, choose one from the list. On a 10+, choose two.

  • You have unequivocal evidence this is true.

  • The shocking truth gives you rightful claim to something they value.

On a miss (6-), it blows up in your face; the MC will tell you how.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks-and-moves.Item.3CLPpupJ1BSyXYwY]{Flash Back to Preparations}

When you flash back to a time you made preparations, answer the following questions, and roll the dice.

  • Did you have plenty of time to do it?

  • Did you have someone looking out for trouble?

On a hit (7+), choose one. On a 7-9, mark a condition, or the MC will tell you how your plotting is flawed or got you caught up in another problem.

  • You have fabricated a piece of evidence; tell us what it is.

  • You arranged for somebody to be in the right place at the right time.

  • You stowed away something hidden.

On a miss (6-), choose one anyway, but the MC says who was lurking in the background and what they did to interfere before the flashback ends.

Conditions are the emotions and psychological distress that PCs will struggle against during play.

When a condition is marked, the PC is in the grip of that emotion.

Each character playbook has four conditions, each granting a +1 bonus to one basic move and a -2 penalty to another. (Reminder: maximum bonus +4; maximum penalty -3.)

When a move or the MC asks you to mark a condition, you can generally choose whichever condition you like.

If you were supposed to mark a condition that isn't on your character playbook, let the MC know and mark a different one instead.

When you must mark a condition but cannot because they are all already marked, your character suffers a full-blown Meltdown. Each playbook has a description of this Meltdown. Read it aloud immediately and have your character act according to what the text demands.

You cannot mark a condition while in the middle of a Meltdown. At the end of the scene in which you fulfilled the demands of your Meltdown, clear all your conditions.
